Players Committee card image of [[Elis In Hinthra (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Elis, who provides ability of 2. Once per game, may use 1 Force to deploy a smuggler aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe a41bae9] (5 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
